'''Sundar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. At some point during the war, Sundar turned against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and took residence in the [[Tomb of Tulak Hord]] in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]]. He and his followers were eventually eliminated by a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from the Academy, and his signet ring was taken from him as proof of his demise.
